jei.slimic.friendly_slime: Use on a block or water to summon your companion. Right-click it to rename it, inspect and upgrade stats, or choose an order. Shift-right-click to recover it with its saved traits.
jei.slimic.mining_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a pickaxe to equip that exact tool. Creative-tab summons start with empty equipment. Pickaxe and shovel slots use native durability, and spare tools are taken from the bag. It excavates downward inside its release chunk, preserving and repairing a two-wide perimeter ramp.
item.slimic.transport_slime.tooltip: Hauls cargo and replacement tools between nearby Slime Chests and your workers.
status.slimic.transport.delivering: Delivering cargo to a Slime Chest
status.slimic.transport.no_chest: No available Slime Chest in the work area
status.slimic.transport.chests_full: Slime Chests are full; keeping cargo safe
status.slimic.transport.unreachable: Cannot reach the target; looking for another route
jei.slimic.transport_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a regular chest. Its bag always holds twice as much as another slime at the same Capacity level. It unloads your stopped, full-bag workers into Slime Chests and brings replacement tools to workers with broken tools. It has no equipment slot.
jei.slimic.slime_chest: Craft eight wooden planks around a slime ball. This 27-slot container stores resources and spare tools for nearby transport slimes. Ordinary chests are not logistics endpoints.
screen.slimic.tuner_help: Edits base stats. Transport doubles Capacity; cleaning multiplies Detection Range by five. Hover over a field for limits.
status.slimic.needs_support: Add common building blocks to repair the ramp
status.slimic.unreachable: The quarry route is blocked; retrying
jei.slimic.herald_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with any firework rocket. It copies that rocket design and signals when your nearby workers remain unable to work for the configured minutes. Rockets are not consumed after summoning. Creative summons use a white round firework.
jei.slimic.slime_tuner: Creative-only tool. Hold and right-click to edit a nearby slime in a separate screen. Stats, health, stamina and unused points can be edited. Survival players cannot use it.
screen.slimic.capacity_occupied: Empty the removed bag slots before reducing Capacity.
item.slimic.slime_armor.tooltip: Equip in a Combat Slime armor slot. Keeps the original chestplate stats and data.
jei.slimic.combat_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a sword. Equip a sword, shield and Slime Armor. Fight nearby enabled target types; defaults to hostile mobs except creepers. Owner and same-owner pets are protected. Filters, stats, equipment and cargo survive recovery.
jei.slimic.cleaning_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with rotten flesh. Collects dropped items inside a fixed release-centered area with five times the shared Detection Range, then returns home. After three minutes without a pickup, tries another item or retries the same one. Transport slimes can unload its full bag.
jei.slimic.slime_armor: Craft any chestplate with one slime ball. Preserves material, damage, enchantments, name, color and attribute modifiers. Combat slimes have one dedicated armor slot.
status.slimic.combat.no_sword: Equip a sword or add a bag spare
status.slimic.cleaning.unreachable: Pickup blocked; retrying or finding another item
screen.slimic.specialization_stat: Used by another specialization; upgrades remain stored.
